items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 28 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01937-1The collapse of the western Baltic herring fishery by the year 1570 caused large disruptions. items.title: Hotter than usual: 13-week longitudinal evidence that experienced heat follows local departures beyond absolute levels across 49 US states
items.title_en: Hotter than usual: 13-week longitudinal evidence that experienced heat follows local departures beyond absolute levels across 49 US states
items.title_zh: 比往常更热：一项为期13周的纵向研究表明，在美国49个州，实际经历的高温与当地温度偏离绝对水平的情况密切相关
items.summary_en: Heat-related mortality risk is rising globally. Impact-based warning tools and environmental heat exposure evidence suggest that heat burden is not fully explained by absolute temperatures, but reflects departures from ‘usual conditions’. Yet individual-level evidence of how people experience heat is scarce. We examined perceived heat as an outcome in its own right in a 13-week longitudinal study comprising 12 435 observations from 1 080 participants across 49 US states during the summer of 2024. Generalized additive mixed models with a within-between decomposition were used, separating within-person temperature deviations from between-person climatic context. Results showed that perceived heat impacts increased nonlinearly as temperatures deviated from locally usual conditions, with no evidence of discrete thresholds or attenuation across the observed range. Within-person sensitivity was strongest in cooler climates, while warmer-climate residents showed flatter responses but somewhat higher baseline impacts, a pattern consistent with climatic moderation of perceptual sensitivity. Humidity was independently associated with within-person variation beyond temperature. Nearly half of the variance in perceived impacts reflected stable between-person differences, with media exposure, political affiliation, age, and housing context associated with impacts beyond meteorological conditions. Taken together, our findings suggest that people experience heat relative to local usual conditions, not only absolute levels. Warning systems anchored to absolute thresholds may systematically underserve populations who reach perceived heat impacts earliest.
items.summary_zh: 全球范围内，与高温相关的死亡风险正在上升。基于影响的预警工具和环境高温暴露证据表明，高温负担并不能完全用绝对温度来解释，而是反映了与“正常状况”的偏差。然而，关于人们如何体验高温的个体层面证据却十分匮乏。 我们在一项为期13周的纵向研究中，将“感知热度”作为独立研究结果进行考察。该研究于2024年夏季开展，涵盖美国49个州的1 080名参与者，共计12 435条观测数据。 研究采用了具有“组内-组间”分解功能的广义加性混合模型，将个体内部的温度偏差与个体间的气候背景区分开来。 结果表明，随着温度偏离当地“通常条件”，热感影响呈非线性增加，在观测范围内未发现离散阈值或衰减现象。在较冷气候地区，个体内的敏感性最强；而在较暖气候地区的居民则表现出较平缓的响应，但基线影响略高，这一模式与气候对感知敏感性的调节作用一致。 湿度与温度之外的个体内部变异存在独立关联。感知影响方差中近一半反映了稳定的个体间差异，其中媒体曝光、政治立场、年龄和居住环境均与气象条件之外的影响相关。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，人们对热感的体验是相对于当地通常条件而言的，而不仅仅是绝对水平。 基于绝对阈值设计的预警系统，可能会系统性地忽视那些最早感受到高温影响的人群。

items.title: 1.7-billion-year-old fossils reveal a crucial clue to the rise of complex life
items.title_en: 1.7-billion-year-old fossils reveal a crucial clue to the rise of complex life
items.title_zh: 17亿年前的化石揭示了复杂生命起源的关键线索
items.summary_en: Scientists studying ancient Australian rocks uncovered more than 12,000 fossils from some of the oldest known eukaryotes on Earth. These early complex cells lived in settings ranging from coastal mudflats to the open sea, but only where oxygen was available. Oxygen-free environments contained simpler microbes instead. The findings strengthen the idea that oxygen played a crucial role in the emergence of complex life.
items.summary_zh: 研究澳大利亚古代岩石的科学家们发现了超过12,000件化石，这些化石属于地球上已知最古老的真核生物。这些早期的复杂细胞栖息于从沿海泥滩到开阔海域的各种环境中，但仅限于有氧气的地方。而在无氧环境中，则存在更简单的微生物。 这一发现进一步印证了氧气在复杂生命出现过程中发挥了关键作用的观点。

items.title: Implementing just fossil fuel transition: extreme Citizen Science to enforce the ban on gas flaring activities in the Ecuadorian Amazon
items.title_en: Implementing just fossil fuel transition: extreme Citizen Science to enforce the ban on gas flaring activities in the Ecuadorian Amazon
items.title_zh: 落实公正的化石燃料转型：通过“极端公民科学”推动厄瓜多尔亚马逊地区实施天然气燃烧禁令
items.summary_en: Oil extraction in the Ecuadorian Amazon Region (EAR) has generated severe environmental and health impacts on Indigenous and rural territories. In response, the climate justice campaign ‘Apaguen los Mecheros’ contributed to a landmark ruling by the Court of Nueva Loja (2021), ordering the progressive shutdown of gas flaring (GF) near populated centers and its complete phase-out by 2030. Yet compliance with this ruling remains highly contested. Grounded in an eight-year Extreme Citizen Science process within the campaign, this study assesses post-ruling compliance through independent satellite-based monitoring, combined for the first time with dedicated ground-mapping fieldwork. The study assesses GF dynamics between 2012 and 2024, detects and validates emerging flare sites, compares this evidence with official documentation on flare shutdowns, and provides an updated estimate of GF in the EAR, combining annual and daily Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Nightfire data, a 2019 participatory ground-truthing dataset and a 2026 ground-mapping survey. Results show that GF in the EAR has not declined since the ruling: active flare sites increased from 58 in 2012 to 91 in 2024, while annual flared volumes rose from 0.82–1.69 billion cubic meter (BCM). Daily detections and ground mapping jointly identified 47 flare sites absent from the 2019 dataset, indicating continued expansion and reconfiguration of flaring infrastructure, disproportionately concentrated in oil blocks that only recently resumed operations. Comparison with official dismantling reports further shows that, of the 110 sites oil companies reported as dismantled under Phase I of the national reduction plan, 72 could be independently assessed and 37 of these (51%) remain active, suggesting that shutdown efforts have prioritized low-activity flares while larger facilities, several near urban centers, continue to expand. Overall, we provide an updated inventory of between 198 and 252 potentially active flares, against 91 sites confirmed as dismantled. Fieldwork further documented flaring practices not previously reported in Ecuador and largely invisible to satellite monitoring such as enclosed ground flares (EGFs) and gas venting. In a wider perspective, this study demonstrates how open-access remote sensing, combined with citizen-generated ground evidence, can support independent, transparent, and scalable verification of environmental compliance in politically contested extractive frontiers.
items.summary_zh: 厄瓜多尔亚马逊地区（EAR）的石油开采给土著和农村地区带来了严重的环境和健康影响。 为此，气候正义运动“Apaguen los Mecheros”促成了新洛哈法院（2021年）的一项里程碑式裁决，该裁决要求逐步关闭人口密集区附近的天然气燃烧设施，并于2030年前彻底淘汰。然而，该裁决的执行情况仍存在巨大争议。 本研究基于该运动中历时八年的“极端公民科学”实践，通过独立的卫星监测——并首次结合专门的地面测绘实地工作——评估了裁决后的执行情况。 本研究评估了2012年至2024年间的天然气燃烧动态，检测并验证了新出现的燃烧点，将这些证据与官方的燃烧关闭记录进行对比，并结合可见光红外成像辐射计套件 （VIIRS）“夜火”（Nightfire）数据、2019年参与式地面实测数据集以及2026年地面测绘调查结果，提供了关于东非地区（EAR）燃气放空的最新估算。 结果表明，自该裁决以来，东亚区域（EAR）的燃气放空量并未减少：活跃的燃气放空点从2012年的58处增加到2024年的91处，而年度燃气放空量则从0.82–1.69十亿立方米（BCM）上升。 通过每日监测与地面测绘相结合，共识别出47处未收录在2019年数据集中的火炬排放点，这表明火炬排放基础设施仍在持续扩张和重组，且这些设施过度集中于近期才恢复运营的石油区块中。 与官方拆除报告的对比进一步显示，在石油公司报告称已根据国家减排计划第一阶段拆除的110处设施中， 其中72处经过了独立评估，而其中37处（51%）仍处于活跃状态，这表明停用工作优先处理了低活跃度的火炬，而规模更大的设施——其中若干位于城市中心附近——却仍在持续扩张。总体而言，我们提供了一份更新后的清单，其中包含198至252处潜在的

items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30389v1 An: new Abstract: Computational Science and Engineering (CSE) combines expertise at the intersection of engineering, a: sustainable computing and sustainable software. We present illustrative examples for these pillars and derive recommendations and best practices for CSE stakeholders. Developing an understanding of how sustainability can create added value in CSE is an important future direction for the field. This calls for a concerted effort within the CSE community to define measurable outcomes and best practices that embed sustainability as a core design principle rather than an afterthought.
